invariants.note: Issue #8 §3.7 requires tooltip, context_menu, modal, and popup. Evaluate when catalog_workloads overlay exports overlay_kind_count.

notes: Mapped onto OverlayHost activate_overlay/dismiss_overlay for Tooltip, Menu (context_menu), Dialog (modal), and AppContext toggle_popover for popup in an isolated AppContext. Measures activate/dismiss only. Does not measure popup pointer-follow reposition, stacking vs host chrome, or OS-owned menus.
